holdout_selection.plan: Score #29 and #47 on 2025+ with the config acceptance rules, then combine both in one account.
holdout_selection.rationale: Chosen by the user (2026-11-14) from a holistic ranking of the 645 validation passers (dev/val Sharpe and PF, all 5 dev years profitable, local-move / grid-neighbor / perturbation stability, cost, delay and missed-entry stress, ES transfer, DSR, beating 99%+ of random entries, low mutual correlation). #54 was also proposed but not selected; the ES v3 holdout (#5 passed, #10 failed) had been seen before this choice.

selection_rules.ordering: median stage-4 Sharpe (local_perturbation) desc, profitable dev years desc, dev Sharpe desc, config_id asc
